rows.note: Use this when an item is available to buy, rather than merely usable or currently in stock.

example.english: This phone is available to buy now.
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 sau2 gei1 ji4 gaa1 jau5 dak1 maai5

rows.note: Use this when a product is available because it is currently in stock.

example.english: This camera is currently available; it is in stock.

rows.note: Use this for something that can be used for the purpose at hand, including a usable person or candidate.

example.english: This plan is still available for use.
